values.Model Name: Annaprashan Decoration Kit Red Gold Balloons Banner Cutouts with LED Light
values.Design: Red and gold balloon arch with heart foil balloons and Annaprashan banner backdrop
Key Features: Red and gold festive colour theme
Easy to assemble with arch tape and pump
values.Description: This Annaprashan decoration kit includes 1 Shubh Annaprashan banner, 20 golden balloons and 20 red balloons for a vibrant setup. The pack also contains 8 red heart foil balloons to create a festive backdrop. A set of 16 printed Annaprashan cutout props covers the rice ceremony theme, including kalash, Ganesh, rice bowl and photo booth signs on sticks. A warm LED string light is included to light up the backdrop for evening celebrations. For easy setup the kit provides 1 balloon pump, 1 arch tape and 1 glue dot strip to arrange the balloons neatly. The materials include latex balloons, foil balloons and printed paper cutouts for a rich look. This decoration set is ideal for a baby's first rice ceremony and small home celebrations, and can be arranged on walls or as a backdrop for photos.
